description: Intent i010 (SNAPSHOT=s03, BRANCH=media-epidx) complete. Searched drivers/media/usb/** in snapshots/s03 for the seed cx231xx mechanism (fixed/assumed endpoint[k] index into altsetting endpoint[] without bNumEndpoints validation). FINDINGS: (1) drivers/media/usb/gspca/stv06xx/stv06xx.c:307-318 stv06xx_isoc_init() hard-indexes actconfig->intf_cache[0]->altsetting[1] and WRITES alt->endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize (OOB write if altsetting 1 declares bNumEndpoints==0) with zero bNumEndpoints/num_altsetting checks in the file (grep-verified); stv06xx_isoc_nego (326-335) repeats the unchecked read/write and feeds usb_set_interface; gspca core's safe alt_xfer runs only AFTER isoc_init (gspca.c:773 vs 783). (2) drivers/media/usb/gspca/xirlink_cit.c:2644-2671 same pattern in sd_isoc_init (write at 2646) and sd_isoc_nego (2668-2676), no bNumEndpoints checks in file. (3) drivers/media/usb/b2c2/flexcop-usb.c:431 medium: flexcop_usb_transfer_init reads cur_altsetting->endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize whose value sizes the usb_alloc_coherent isoc buffer; the bNumEndpoints<1 guard (line 514) checks the post-usb_set_interface(0,1) altsetting in flexcop_usb_init, residual risk if cur_altsetting changes again before transfer_init. Triaged 12 candidates: konica.c, stk1160, usbtv, em28xx, gspca.c core, dib0700, smsusb, tm6000, cxusb, au0828 (+hdpvr/pwc/s2255/stkwebcam/zr364xx/uvc) all bounds-safe with explicit bNumEndpoints-bounded loops or checks; ov519.c:3480/3606 and stv06xx_pb0100.c:188 remain unresolved same-class endpoint[0] reads lacking checks. Limitations: only media-usb tree of s03 searched (sibling intents own net-usb/rest/if-alt-count); no compile/exec exploit demonstration — static evidence only; seed cx231xx files in s03 already fixed and excluded.
